Dispel types were checked against in-game tooltips.

items: Drop {Surging Totem} on cooldown where the party is stacked, and drop {Healing Stream Totem} on cooldown since {Lively Totems} fires a free {Chain Heal}
Tank busters to keep {Riptide} and {Earth Shield} on the tank and save {Nature's Swiftness} for: {busters}

farseer.title: Farseer notes
items: Summon the Ancestor with {Unleash Life} and {Ancestral Swiftness}, and activate {Ascendance} right before big AoE damage
Tank busters to have an instant {Healing Wave} ready via {Ancestral Swiftness} (30 sec): {busters}

Rav'i: [광역 피해] Topicx uses party defensives on Ravenous Stomp (145474 Nature to the whole party), so drop Spirit Link Totem in the middle of the party right before Stomp, and use Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) during Ssscavenging
[탱버] Hydrastrike's three hits are Physical damage. Put Riptide on the tank before the cast and make sure Earth Shield stays up
[해제] Restoration Shaman cannot remove the Regurgitate disease, so leave it to a player who can dispel diseases
The Writhing Coil: [차단] Put Wind Shear into the rotation for the 3 back-to-back Toxic Atrophy interrupts. With a 12 sec cooldown, take only one
[해제] When Spiteful Venom poison stacks on the Spiteful Hunt target, drop Poison Cleansing Totem within 30 yards of them
[광역 피해] During the 35 sec Synchronized Venom DoT, drop Healing Stream Totem and Stormstream Totem on cooldown to cover it
Zul'jan: [광역 피해] Party defensives go on the Ritual of the Fang beam soak channel (Topicx). Everyone returns to the same spot for each Ritual, so put Riptide on the beam soakers before the channel and alternate Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) with Spirit Link Totem on each channel
[참고] Pre-place Riptide on players who deliberately take Boneslicer or a slowed Axegrinder axe to clear Ritual Venom so they can absorb the Physical damage
[탱버] If the tank is low during Chop Down's two hits (484912 Physical each), cast an instant Healing Wave with Nature's Swiftness (Ancestral Swiftness for Farseer)

Lightblossom Trinity: [광역 피해] Line up Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) with the 8 sec Lightbloom Overgrowth AoE damage

[탱버] Bedrock Slam (484912 Physical + 193965 Nature) comes soon after the Lightblossom Beam soak ends, so put Riptide on the tank as the soak ends and, if their health is low, top them off right away with Nature's Swiftness (Ancestral Swiftness for Farseer) and Healing Wave
[회피] If you stepped into Fertile Loam to block the beam, clear its 50% slow with Ghost Wolf (Thunderous Paws) after the soak and get out immediately
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [해제] Per the tooltip, Bloodthorn Roots is a magic effect. Free rooted allies with Purify Spirit (one every 8 sec)
[광역 피해] Use Spirit Link Totem for the 6 sec Thorncaller Roar AoE, and save Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) for Lightcrazed Frenzy after 50%
[회피] If targeted by Bloodthirsty Gaze, gain distance with Gust of Wind or Ghost Wolf
Lightwarden Ruia: [차단] Warden's Wrath in Moonkin Form is repeated Nature damage on the tank, so kick it with Wind Shear
[참고] Taking a Pulverizing Strikes cone with the Grievous Thrash bleed still up is dangerous, so heal bleeding party members to 100% with Riptide and Healing Wave before the cone to clear the bleed
[광역 피해] After 40%, use Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) for Spirits of the Vale, and add Spirit Link Totem when abilities overlap
Ziekket: [탱버] Thornspike hits the tank for 193965 Holy plus a 10 sec Physical bleed (58189 per sec) and knocks them back, so put Riptide on the tank before the cast and keep healing the bleed with Healing Wave from within 40 yards after the knockback
[차단] Before the revive, Wind Shear the Lashers' Lightspore Shot (usually aimed at the tank). Revived Lashers are immune to interrupts

[광역 피해] Cover the constant Oozing Xylem damage by dropping Healing Stream Totem and Stormstream Totem on cooldown, and move your totems with Totemic Projection when the party follows the Concentrated Lightbeam target

The Hoardmonger: [해제] Clear Toxic Spores poison stacks with Poison Cleansing Totem. Dropping it as the Spoiled Supplies mushroom soak ends cleanses several people in turn
[광역 피해] Use Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) for Ravenous Bellow, and alternate Spirit Link Totem for the Ravenous Bellows in between
Sentinel of Winter: [해제] Clear the Glacial Torment magic DoT with Purify Spirit
[차단] Put Wind Shear into the rotation for Fractured Shivercore's Winter's Shroud
[위치] If you have to move inside a Snowdrift during Frozen Tempest, pop Spiritwalker's Grace and keep healing
Nalorakk: [광역 피해] Overwhelming Onslaught (315193 armor-ignoring Physical to everyone every 1 sec for 3 sec, knockback on the last hit) hits both the tank and the party, so drop Spirit Link Totem in the middle of the party behind Zul'jarra's shield on the cast and refill with Stormstream Totem and Chain Heal right after the knockback

[탱버] Put Riptide on the tank taking Forceful Slam (775859 Physical within 6 yards) right after the knockback, and if they are low, cast an instant Healing Wave with Nature's Swiftness (Ancestral Swiftness for Farseer)

[광역 피해] Line up Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) with Fury of the War God, and pre-place Riptide on Echoing Maul targets (Echo deals 193965 Nature within 8 yards) when the mark appears

Kystia Manaheart: [해제] Clear the Corroding Spittle magic DoT with Purify Spirit. With an 8 sec cooldown, dispel the lowest-health target first when several are hit
[차단] Use Wind Shear on the Mirror Images clones' Felstorm, and stop grouped clones together with Capacitor Totem
[광역 피해] Alternate Healing Tide Totem (Totemic)/Ascendance (Farseer) and Spirit Link Totem across Destabilized windows
Zaen Bladesorrow: [광역 피해] The worker pack dragged in after the RP makes the opening hit hard (Topicx), so cast Bloodlust as the second lust and use Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) with it
[해제] Remove the tank's Heartstop Poison after Envenom (30% max health reduction, 15 sec Nature DoT) with Poison Cleansing Totem. The tank must be within 30 yards of the totem

[광역 피해] Topicx says to rotate party defensives on the Killing Spree AoE and names Spirit Link Totem directly. Split Killing Spree casts with the other party defensives, and drop Spirit Link Totem on the one that overlaps with Fel-Infused Freight DoTs
Xathuux the Annihilator: [탱버] If the tank is in danger during the 8 sec Legion Strike healing reduction, pull them up with Spirit Link Totem's health redistribution. The redistribution isn't healing (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Roll Riptide on several people before Infernal Crush, and line up Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) with the AoE at the end of Demonic Rage
[회피] Pop Spiritwalker's Grace when moving to dodge Burning Steps pools
Lithiel Cinderfury: [차단] Put Wind Shear into the rotation for Chaos Bolt
[참고] When Wild Imps group up, stun them with Capacitor Totem to stop Felfire Burst
[광역 피해] Cover the constant Searing Fel Flame damage by dropping Healing Stream Totem and Stormstream Totem on cooldown

Taz'Rah: [광역 피해] Line up Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) with Dark Bloom
[위치] Kiting the boss along the wall leaves your totems behind, so move them toward the party with Totemic Projection
[회피] If you have to heal while dodging Void Fissure orbs, pop Spiritwalker's Grace
Atroxus: [광역 피해] Use Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) when Monstrous Roar hits while a Toxic Creeper is alive
[탱버] Put Riptide on the tank before Hulking Claw; if it's dangerous, use Nature's Swiftness for an instant Healing Wave
[해제] Poison Splash and Mind-Numbing Poison are poisons, so drop Poison Cleansing Totem right after Poison Splash to clear them (Wowhead)
Charonus: [광역 피해] Take Cosmic Crash's 20 sec DoT (116379 Shadow within 8 yards, then 14547 Shadow every 1 sec for 20 sec) with Healing Stream Totem and Stormstream Totem, and while orb-dragging DPS spread toward the Singularities, use Healing Tide Totem (Totemic), which heals everyone within 40 yards, or Ascendance (Farseer). Drop Spirit Link Totem (10 yards) once the party regroups

[참고] Drop Wind Rush Totem (1 min 30 sec with Ascending Air, 40% movement speed for 7 sec when passing through) on the path Gravitic Orbs targets take to a Singularity to offset the Condensed Mass slow, and pre-place Riptide on the targets
[위치] If you must walk against the Unstable Singularity pull, turn on Spiritwalker's Grace and keep healing

The Golden Serpent: [광역 피해] Assign Spirit Link Totem or Ascendance (Farseer) to Serpentine Gust; Totemic should pre-place Surging Totem where the party stands
[참고] When Animated Gold groups up, stun them with Capacitor Totem to delay them reaching the boss
Mchimba the Embalmer: [차단] Put Wind Shear into the rotation for the Mummy's Wretched Discharge
[광역 피해] Right after Awakening Slam, top the party off with Stormstream Totem and Chain Heal
[참고] Put Riptide on the Drain Fluids target and quickly heal them above 90% with Nature's Swiftness and Healing Wave to clear Desiccation
The Council of Tribes: [차단] Kick Zanazal's Poison Nova with Wind Shear, and if it is missed, clear the 12 sec poison DoT with Poison Cleansing Totem

[광역 피해] From the moment Zanazal is engaged, Arc Lightning (135775 Nature) hits the tank and jumps to nearby players. Drop Healing Stream Totem near the tank and heal it with Chain Heal, but when Thundering Totem's Disruption interrupts casts, heal with instant spells such as Riptide and totems

[탱버] Keep Riptide and Earth Shield on the tank until Shattered Defenses from Aka'ali's Debilitating Backhand (727368 Physical) ends, and when the tank takes a Backhand instead of kiting it, cast an instant Healing Wave with Nature's Swiftness
Dazar, The First King: [차단] Put Wind Shear in the kick rotation for Reban's Deathly Roar so the group kills Reban before T'zala joins at 80%

[광역 피해] Use Spirit Link Totem on Gilded Destruction and stack Ascendance as Farseer. As Totemic, save Stormstream Totem and drop it in this window too, and turn on Spiritwalker's Grace when Impaling Spear and Quaking Leap keep you moving

[탱버] Save Nature's Swiftness in phase 1, and after 80%, when Blade Combo follows right after Savage Maul's bleed (48491 Physical every 1 sec for 10 sec, cannot be removed), put Riptide on the tank and cast an instant Healing Wave with Nature's Swiftness (Ancestral Swiftness for Farseer)

Melidrussa Chillworn: [차단] The tank kicks Frigid Shard right after the Hailburst ice lands and drags the boss off the ice (Topicx). Only use Wind Shear on Frigid Shard when the tank's kick is on cooldown
[광역 피해] Assign one of Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) and Spirit Link Totem each to Frost Overload in the 66% and 33% intermissions

[해제] Infused Whelp's Cold Claws is a Magic effect that becomes Frozen Solid at 20 stacks, so clear the players with the most stacks first with Purify Spirit. With many whelps the stacks rebuild before Purify Spirit (8 sec) is back, so pick the player closest to 20 stacks first
Kokia Blazehoof: [차단] Put Wind Shear into the rotation for Blazebound Firestorm's Blaze Volley
[광역 피해] Cover the stacking Inferno DoT with Healing Stream Totem and Stormstream Totem, and use major cooldowns when stacks get high
[탱버] During the 4-hit Searing Blows, put Riptide on the tank and keep Healing Wave going
Kyrakka & Erkhart Stormvein: [참고] Near the end of the Interrupting Cloudburst cast, heal with instants like Riptide and Healing Stream Totem
[광역 피해] Stack Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) in phase 2
[해제] The Stormslam debuff (381515) is a magic effect. It increases the tank's Nature damage taken by 100% for 30 sec and stacks, so Purify Spirit it before the next Stormslam

Adderis & Aspix: [광역 피해] While the party stacks in melee for Thunder and Lightning, drop Healing Rain (Farseer) or Surging Totem (Totemic) there
[광역 피해] Save Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) for the Frenzy phase after Adderis dies
Merektha: [해제] Clear Toxic Viper's Poison Spit poison with Poison Cleansing Totem
[차단] Put Wind Shear in the kick rotation for Toxic Viper's Poison Spit

[광역 피해] Topicx uses party defensives on Serpentstorm (4 sec cast, a knockback with 116379 Nature, then 29095 Nature every 1 sec for 8 sec). Drop Spirit Link Totem on Serpentstorm, and alternate Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) on the next one
Galvazzt: [참고] Pre-apply Riptide to party members blocking beams so they can take the Galvanized damage
[광역 피해] Right after the Induction AoE damage, top the party off with Stormstream Totem and Chain Heal
Avatar of Sethraliss: [참고] During the 30 sec healing phase, heal the Avatar directly with Healing Wave and Riptide. Farseer should pop Ascendance so Healing Wave always crits
[참고] Healing Tide Totem only heals party members, so don't rely on it for healing the Avatar
[위치] When Faithless Tormentors rush in, stun them with Capacitor Totem to buy the tank time to pick them up

383016.d: Purify Spirit additionally removes all Curse effects.

443418.d:
Lava Burst gains an additional charge and deals 10% increased damage.

Riptide gains an additional charge and heals for 20% more.

443450.d:
Unleash Life calls an Ancestor to your side for 12 sec.

Whenever you cast a healing or damaging spell, the Ancestor will cast a similar spell.

443454.d:
Your next healing or damaging spell is instant, costs no mana, and deals 10% increased damage and healing.

If you know Nature's Swiftness, it is replaced by Ancestral Swiftness and causes Ancestral Swiftness to call an Ancestor to your side for 8 sec.

444995.m: Talent · 6.5% of base mana · 40 yd range · Instant · 25 sec cooldown
444995.d:
Summons a totem at the target location that maintains Healing Rain with 10% increased effectiveness for 25 sec.

Replaces Healing Rain.

445025.d: Chain Heal now jumps to a nearby totem within 20 yards once it reaches its last target, causing the totem to cast Chain Heal on an injured ally within 30 yards for (220.5% of Spell Power). Jumps to 2 nearby targets within 20 yards.

445031.d: If you have a totem active, your totem grants you a shield absorbing (Total Health * 6 / 100) damage for 30 sec every 30 sec.

445033.d:
Learn a new weapon imbue, Tidecaller's Guard.

Tidecaller's Guard
Imbue your shield with the element of Water for 1 hour. Your healing done is increased by 2.0% and the duration of your Healing Stream Totem is increased by 3.0 sec.

445034.d: When you summon a Healing Tide Totem, Healing Stream Totem, or Spirit Link Totem you cast a free instant Chain Heal at 100% effectiveness.

445035.d:
Your Healing Stream Totems heals an additional ally at 30% effectiveness.

Healing Tide Totem healing increased by 25%.

457481.d: Imbue your shield with the element of Water for 1 hour. Your healing done is increased by 2.0% and the duration of your Healing Stream Totem is increased by 3.0 sec.

462440.d: The cooldown of Ascendance and Healing Tide Totem is reduced by 60 sec.

462443.d: Your haste is increased by 25% while Ascendance or Healing Tide Totem is active and their durations are increased by 3 sec.

462791.d: Wind Rush Totem's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec and its movement speed effect lasts an additional 2 sec.

462854.m: 1% of base mana · 40 yd range · Instant
462854.d:
Harness the fury of the Windlord to grant a target ally 2% Mastery and empower their auto attacks to have a 20% chance to instantly strike again for 1 hour.

If the target is in your party or raid, all party and raid members will be affected. (Proc chance: 20%, 100ms cooldown)

470411.m: 0.3% of base mana · 40 yd range · Instant · 6 sec cooldown
470411.d:
Sears the target with fire, causing (22.425% of Spell Power) Volcanic damage and then an additional (120.06% of Spell Power) Volcanic damage over 18 sec.

Flame Shock can be applied to a maximum of 6 targets.

1217622.d: Earth Shield and Water Shield no longer lose charges and are 115% effective.

1254251.d: Reduces the cooldown of Riptide by 1.0 sec.

1267068.m: 1.8% of base mana · Instant · 30 sec cooldown
1267068.d: Summons a totem at your feet that immediately heals 2 injured allies for (1323% of Spell Power) and additional heals 2 injured allies within 40 yards for (67.68% of Spell Power) every 2 sec for 15 sec.

370.m: 특성 · 14% (기본 마나 중) · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시
370.d: 적을 정화하여 1개의 이로운 마법 효과를 제거합니다.[정화에 성공하면 소용돌이치는 무기 효과 하나를 얻습니다.]

974.m: 특성 · 5% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시
974.d:
대상에게 대지의 보호막을 둘러 대상 치유 시 치유량이 20%만큼 증가하고, 대상이 공격당할 때 [(주문력의 73%) * (1.2)]의 생명력을 회복하게 합니다. 이 회복은 3초마다 한 번씩만 발동되며, 최대 9회까지 발동합니다.

[정령의 궤도: 대지의 보호막은 한 번에 주술사와 다른 한 대상에게만 걸어둘 수 있습니다. 주술사는 자신에게 최대 두 개의 원소 보호막을 부여할 수 있습니다 / 대지의 보호막은 한 번에 한 대상에게만 걸어둘 수 있습니다. 주술사는 자신에게 하나의 원소 보호막을 유지할 수 있습니다.] (3초 재사용 대기시간)

1064.m: 특성 · 15% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 2 초 주문 시전 시간
1064.d: 아군 대상의 생명력을 (주문력의 231%)만큼 회복시키고, 최대 20미터 내의 가장 생명력이 낮은 주위 아군 3명의 생명력을 회복시킵니다. 전달될 때마다 치유량이 30%만큼 감소합니다.

2008.m: 0.8% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 10 초 주문 시전 시간
2008.d: 죽은 자의 영혼을 육체로 불러들여 최대 생명력과 마나의 35%를 지니고 살아나게 합니다. 전투 중에는 사용할 수 없습니다.

2645.d: 늑대 정령으로 변신합니다. 이동 속도가 [알아키르의 바람: 30 / 30]%만큼 증가하고, 이동 속도가 100% 미만으로 떨어지지 않습니다.

2825.m: 0.4% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 5 분 재사용 대기시간 · 진영: 호드
2825.d:
40초 동안 모든 파티원과 공격대원의 가속을 30%만큼 증가시킵니다.

효과를 받은 대상은 만족함 상태가 되어 10분 동안 피의 욕망 또는 시간 왜곡 효과를 받지 못합니다.

5394.m: 특성 · 5% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간
5394.d:
15초 동안 시전자의 위치에 토템을 소환하여, 2초마다 40미터 반경 내의 [세찬 물결: 부상당한 파티원 또는 공격대원 2명을 / 부상당한 파티원 또는 공격대원 하나를] (주문력의 67.68%)만큼 치유합니다.

이미 치유의 토템을 배운 상태라면, 그 대신 치유의 토템이 추가로 1회 충전됩니다.

8004.m: 10% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 1.5 초 주문 시전 시간
8004.d: 빠르게 쇄도하는 치유의 파도입니다. 아군 대상의 생명력을 (주문력의 1100%)만큼 회복시킵니다.

20608.d: 20%의 생명력과 마나를 지닌 채로 스스로 죽음에서 부활할 수 있습니다. 이 효과는 30분에 한 번씩만 발동합니다.

30884.d: 생명력이 35% 미만으로 떨어지면 최대 생명력의 40%만큼 생명력이 즉시 회복됩니다. 45초마다 1번씩만 발동됩니다.

32182.m: 0.4% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 5 분 재사용 대기시간 · 진영: 얼라이언스
32182.d:
모든 파티원과 공격대원의 가속을 40초 동안 30%만큼 증가시킵니다.

효과를 받은 대상은 기력이 소진되어 10분 동안 영웅심이나 시간 왜곡 효과를 받지 못합니다.

51505.m: 특성 · 0.5% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 2 초 주문 시전 시간 · 8 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
51505.d: 대상에게 용해된 용암을 날려 (주문력의 181%)의 화염 피해를 입힙니다. 대상에게 화염 충격이 걸려 있으면 용암 폭발은 언제나 극대화 효과를 발휘하며, 치명타 및 극대화율에 따라 추가 피해를 입힙니다.

51564.d:
성난 해일 시전 시 굽이치는 물결 1중첩이 부여됩니다. 굽이치는 물결은 다음 치유의 물결이나 연쇄 치유의 시전 시간을 20%만큼 감소시킵니다.

최대 2번까지 중첩됩니다.

52127.d:
물방울이 시전자 주위에 머무르며, 5초당 마나 회복량을 69만큼 증가시킵니다. 근접 공격에 적중당하면 시전자는 마나의 [쇄도의 보호막: 3 / 2]%를 회복합니다. 이 효과는 3초마다 한 번씩만 발동합니다.

[정령의 궤도: 주술사는 자신에게 최대 두 개의 원소 보호막을 부여할 수 있습니다 / 원소 보호막은 동시에 하나만 유지할 수 있습니다.] (3초 재사용 대기시간)

57994.m: 특성 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 12 초 재사용 대기시간
57994.d: 강풍을 날려보내 대상의 주문 시전을 방해하고, 4초 동안 대상이 같은 계열의 주문을 시전하지 못하게 합니다.

61295.m: 특성 · 1.52% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 6 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
61295.d: 복원의 힘이 담긴 물로 아군 대상을 씻어 생명력을 (주문력의 600%)만큼 회복시키고, 추가로 18초에 걸쳐 (주문력의 478.2%)만큼 회복시킵니다.

73685.m: 0.8% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 20 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
73685.d:
생명의 정기를 방출해 아군 대상을 (주문력의 1220%)만큼 치유합니다.

다음 성난 해일, 연쇄 치유 또는 치유의 물결의 치유량이 25%만큼 증가하며, 시전 시간은 30%만큼 감소합니다.

73920.m: 특성 · 4.32% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 2 초 주문 시전 시간 · 12 초 재사용 대기시간
73920.d:
대상 지역에 치유의 비를 내려 18초에 걸쳐 최대 6명의 아군 생명력을 [(주문력의 108%) * 6 * 2 / 5.19999981]만큼 회복시킵니다.

치유의 비는 한 번에 하나만 활성화할 수 있습니다.

77130.m: 1.3% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 8 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
77130.d: 아군 대상에게 걸린 모든 마법 [영혼 정화 연마: 및 저주] 효과를 제거합니다.

77472.m: 2.38% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 2 초 주문 시전 시간
77472.d: 효율적인 치유의 물결로 아군 대상의 생명력을 (주문력의 1501%)만큼 회복시킵니다.

79206.m: 특성 · 2.82% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
79206.d: 15초 동안 영혼의 인도를 받아 이동 중에도 주술사 주문을 시전할 수 있습니다. 이 주문은 다른 주문 시전 중에도 시전할 수 있습니다.

98008.m: 특성 · 2.2% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 3 분 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
98008.d: 6초 동안 대상 위치에 토템을 소환합니다. 토템은 주위 10미터 반경 내의 모든 파티원과 공격대원이 받는 피해를 10%만큼 감소시킵니다. 고리로 연결된 모든 플레이어의 생명력이 즉시, 그리고 1초마다 고르게 재분배됩니다.

108271.d: 영혼 일부를 안전한 정령계로 옮겨 12초 동안 받는 피해를 40%만큼 감소시킵니다.

108280.m: 특성 · 1.12% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 3 분 재사용 대기시간
108280.d:
10초 동안 시전자의 위치에 토템을 소환합니다. 토템은 2초마다 박동하며 40미터 내의 모든 파티원 또는 공격대원의 생명력을 (주문력의 514.5%)만큼 회복시킵니다.

대상이 5명을 초과하면 치유량이 감소합니다.

108287.m: 특성 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 10 초 재사용 대기시간

114052.d:
즉시 20미터 내 아군을 (주문력의 1287.72%)만큼 나누어 치유하고, 15초 동안 물의 승천자로 변신합니다.

승천한 동안 연쇄 치유 시전 시 3명의 추가 아군에게 전달되고, 전달될 때마다 치유량이 10%만큼 감소합니다. 치유의 물결은 항상 치명타 및 극대화 효과를 발휘하고 50%의 효율로 1명의 추가 아군을 치유합니다. 또한 연쇄 치유와 치유의 물결의 마나 소모량이 25%만큼 감소합니다.

188196.m: 0.2% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 2.5 초 주문 시전 시간
188196.d: 대상에게 번개 화살을 날려 (주문력의 170%)의 자연 피해를 입힙니다.

188443.m: 특성 · 0.2% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 2 초 주문 시전 시간
188443.d: 적에게 번개를 날려 (주문력의 116.4%)의 자연 피해를 입히고 주위 적을 연쇄적으로 가격합니다. 최대 3명의 대상을 공격합니다.

192058.m: 특성 · 2% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간
192058.d: 대상 위치에 토템을 소환하여 주위 공기에서 전기 에너지를 흡수합니다. 토템은 2초 후에 폭발하여 8미터 내의 모든 적들을 3초 동안 기절시킵니다.

192077.m: 특성 · 1% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
192077.d: 대상 위치에 토템을 15초 동안 소환합니다. 토템은 10미터 반경 내에서 이동하는 모든 아군의 이동 속도를 5초 동안 40%만큼 증가시킵니다.

192088.d: 영혼나그네의 은총의 재사용 대기시간이 30초만큼 감소하고, 영혼나그네의 은총이 활성화되어 있는 동안 이동 속도가 20%만큼 증가합니다.

200076.d: 자신의 치유의 비 또는 성난 해일의 효과를 받는 대상에 대한 치유의 물결, 연쇄 치유의 치유량이 추가로 15%만큼 증가합니다.

333919.d: 성난 해일과 용암 폭발이 추가로 1회 충전됩니다.

378075.d: 늑대 정령 시전 시 감속 효과를 제거하고 처음 3초 동안 이동 속도가 추가로 25%만큼 증가합니다. 20초에 한 번씩만 발동합니다. (20초 재사용 대기시간)

378081.d: 다음 치유 또는 공격 자연 주문이 마나를 소모하지 않고 즉시 시전됩니다.

378443.d: 치유의 비의 범위 내에 있는 최대 5명의 적에게 2초마다 [(주문력의 100%)]의 자연 피해를 입힙니다.

382020.d: 대지의 보호막이 받는 피해를 3%만큼 감소시키고, 대상의 생명력이 감소할수록 받는 치유 효과가 증가해 최대 150%만큼 증가합니다. 대상의 생명력이 50% 미만으로 떨어지면 효과가 최대에 도달합니다.

382021.d: 1시간 동안 무기에 대지의 원소를 주입합니다. 성난 해일, 치유의 물결, 연쇄 치유로 치유 시 20%의 확률로 대상에게 대지생명을 부여하여 6초에 걸쳐 (주문력의 138.915%)의 생명력을 회복시킵니다.

382045.d: 성난 해일을 4번 시전할 때마다 성난 해일 대상 주위에 있는 또 다른 아군 대상에게도 성난 해일을 부여합니다.

383010.d:
자신에게 부여할 수 있는 원소 보호막의 수가 1만큼 증가합니다.

대지의 보호막을 동시에 자신과 한 명의 아군에게 걸 수 있습니다.

383013.m: 특성 · 0.5% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
383013.d: 발 밑에 토템을 소환하여 6초 동안 1.5초마다 30미터 내에 있는 주위의 파티원 또는 공격대원의 독 효과를 모두 제거합니다.

383016.d: 영혼 정화가 추가로 모든 저주 효과를 제거합니다.

443418.d:
용암 폭발이 추가로 1회 충전되고 10%의 추가 피해를 입힙니다.

성난 해일이 추가로 1회 충전되고 20%의 생명력을 추가로 회복시킵니다.

443450.d:
생명 폭발 시전 시 12초 동안 곁에 선조를 소환합니다.

치유 또는 공격 주문을 시전할 때마다 선조가 비슷한 주문을 시전합니다.

443454.d:
다음 치유 또는 공격 주문이 즉시 시전되고 마나를 소모하지 않으며, 공격력과 치유량이 10%만큼 증가합니다.

자연의 신속함을 배웠을 경우 선조의 신속함으로 대체됩니다. 추가로 선조의 신속함이 8초 동안 곁에 선조를 소환합니다.

444995.m: 특성 · 6.5% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 25 초 재사용 대기시간
444995.d:
대상 위치에 토템을 소환하여 25초 동안 효과가 10%만큼 증가한 치유의 비를 시전하게 합니다.

치유의 비를 대체합니다.

445025.m: 특성 · 매 분마다 약 10번 효과 발동됨
445025.d: 연쇄 치유가 마지막 대상까지 전달되면 주위 20미터 내의 토템으로 전달됩니다. 이후 해당 토템이 30미터 내의 부상당한 아군에게 연쇄 치유를 시전하여 (주문력의 220.5%)만큼 치유하며, 20미터 내에 있는 주위 대상 2명에게 전달됩니다.

445031.d: 토템이 활성화되어 있으면 토템이 30초마다 30초 동안 (총 생명력 * 6 / 100)의 피해를 흡수하는 보호막을 부여합니다.

445033.d:
새로운 무기 강화 능력 파도소환사의 수호를 배웁니다.

파도소환사의 수호
1시간 동안 방패에 물의 정기를 주입합니다. 치유량이 2.0%만큼, 치유의 토템의 지속시간이 3.0초만큼 증가합니다.

445034.d: 치유의 해일 토템, 치유의 토템, 정신의 고리 토템 소환 시 연쇄 치유가 자원을 소모하지 않고 100%의 효율로 즉시 시전됩니다.

445035.d:
치유의 토템이 30%의 효율로 추가 아군 대상을 치유합니다.

치유의 해일 토템의 치유량이 25%만큼 증가합니다.

457481.d: 1시간 동안 방패에 물의 정기를 주입합니다. 치유량이 2.0%만큼, 치유의 토템의 지속시간이 3.0초만큼 증가합니다.

462440.d: 승천 및 치유의 해일 토템의 재사용 대기시간이 60초만큼 감소합니다.

462443.d: 승천 또는 치유의 해일 토템이 활성화된 동안 가속이 25%만큼, 해당 효과의 지속시간은 3초만큼 증가됩니다.

462791.d: 바람 질주 토템의 재사용 대기시간이 30초만큼 감소하고 이동 속도 증가 효과의 지속시간이 2초만큼 추가로 증가합니다.

462854.d:
바람의 군주의 분노를 이용해 1시간 동안 대상 아군의 특화를 2%만큼 증가시키고 자동 공격 시 20%의 확률로 즉시 다시 한번 공격을 가하게 합니다.

대상이 같은 파티나 공격대에 속해 있다면, 모든 파티원과 공격대원이 효과를 받습니다. (효과 발동 확률: 20%, 100밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

470411.m: 0.3% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 6 초 재사용 대기시간
470411.d:
대상을 불로 그을려 (주문력의 22.425%)의 화산 피해를 입히고, 추가로 18초에 걸쳐 총 (주문력의 120.06%)의 화산 피해를 입힙니다.

최대 6명의 대상에게 화염 충격을 부여할 수 있습니다.

1217622.d: 대지의 보호막 및 물의 보호막의 충전 횟수가 더는 소모되지 않으며 115%의 효율을 발휘합니다.

1267068.m: 1.8% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간
1267068.d: 발밑에 토템을 소환하여 즉시 2명의 부상당한 아군을 (주문력의 1323%)만큼 치유하고, 추가로 40미터 내의 부상당한 아군 2명을 15초 동안 2초마다 (주문력의 67.68%)만큼 치유합니다.

1: [광역 피해] Once everything is gathered, cast Bloodlust or Heroism and line up Healing Tide Totem (Totemic, 2 min with First Ascendant) or Ascendance (Farseer, 3 min) with Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret (87284 Holy to the whole party every 2 sec for 6 sec).

[차단] Take one of the two interrupt slots on Radiant Spellsower's Light Bolt Volley (4 sec cast, 174568 Holy to the whole party) with Wind Shear (12 sec). A kicked Spellsower is locked out of that school for 4 sec and walks to the tank.

[차단] If a low-health Radiant Spellsower runs to a sleeping Lasher pack with Call The Grove and starts Frantic Blooming (8 sec channel), drop Capacitor Totem (1 min, 3 sec stun within 8 yards after 2 sec) on it to break the channel.
2: [광역 피해] Healing Tide Totem and Ascendance from pull 1 are not back yet. Drop Healing Stream Totem and Surging Totem (Healing Rain for Farseer) before Spouting Floret, and add Spirit Link Totem (3 min) in the middle of the party if even one Light Bolt Volley overlaps the Floret.
[차단] Kick one of the two Radiant Spellsowers' Light Bolt Volley with Wind Shear. If both casts line up and Capacitor Totem is back, drop it where the two stand to stun both.
3: [참고] Thornblade from the two Underbrush Stalkers deals 96982 Nature, then leaves a 77586 Physical bleed every 2 sec for 12 sec that this spec cannot dispel. Put Riptide on the target and top them off with Healing Wave.
[차단] Put Wind Shear in the Light Bolt Volley rotation for the two Radiant Spellsowers, and if one flees with Call The Grove, break its Frantic Blooming channel with Capacitor Totem.
5: [광역 피해] Sporeblight Belcher is pulled first, so Spouting Floret comes right at the start. Use Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) here if it is back; as Farseer, if Ascendance is still on cooldown, cover it with Healing Stream Totem and Stormstream Totem.

[차단] Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech (4 sec cast) disorients the party for 3 sec and stops your healing too, so kick it with Wind Shear. Stop Thorny Saptor's Thornclaw Leap follow-up attacks with a Capacitor Totem stun.
7: [탱버] Grievous Gash (387930 Physical) from the two Luminous Thornmaws stacks a 48491 Physical bleed every 1 sec for 16 sec that only drops at full health. Put Riptide on the tank after every Gash and heal them to 100% with Healing Wave to clear the bleed. As Farseer, use Unleash Life first to boost the next Healing Wave by 25%.
[차단] Kick Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech with Wind Shear, and stop both Thorny Saptors' Thornclaw Leap with one Capacitor Totem where they stand together.
8: [광역 피해] Pre-place Healing Stream Totem and Surging Totem (Healing Rain for Farseer) to take Spouting Floret.
[차단] If Capacitor Totem (1 min) from pull 7 is back, stun the two Thorny Saptors' Thornclaw Leap with it and spend Wind Shear on Leafy Grovecrawler's Seed Shot (116379 Nature).
10: [해제] When Potatoad Matriarch starts Toxic Spew (2 sec cast), stand in the middle of the party and drop Poison Cleansing Totem (2 min). The totem spawns at your feet and removes all poison from one party member within 30 yards every 1.5 sec for 6 sec, so drop it before the cast ends to clear everyone before the 9 sec poison (58189 Nature every 1.5 sec) ramps up (Wowhead: Poison Cleansing Totem is useful in this dungeon).
11: [광역 피해] Spouting Floret overlaps the Luminous Thornmaw's Grievous Gash bleed, so use Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) here if it is back. During Ascendance Healing Wave always crits, which makes it easy to top the tank to 100% and clear the bleed.
[차단] One Wind Shear cannot stop three Lightfeather Petalwings' Disorienting Screech, so drop Capacitor Totem where the tank has gathered them to stun all three.
12: [광역 피해] This is the last big pull, so spend whatever is left of Healing Tide Totem or Ascendance and Spirit Link Totem. Drop Spirit Link Totem in the middle of the party (10 yard radius) when Spouting Floret and the two Radiant Spellsowers' Light Bolt Volley overlap.

[차단] Put Wind Shear in the Light Bolt Volley rotation. A Lightgorged Lasher shielded by Lightbloom Pollination is immune to crowd control, so save Capacitor Totem for a Radiant Spellsower fleeing with Call The Grove.

1: [차단] The two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss (4 sec cast, 135775 armor-ignoring Physical, 30% haste reduction for 6 sec) needs one kicker per Serpent, so take one of them with Wind Shear (12 sec).

[해제] Twinfang Harrower's Paralyzing Shots (48491 Nature every 1 sec for 20 sec, 10% slow per tick) is a Magic effect, so clear it one player at a time with Purify Spirit (8 sec). Clear melee first since they must dodge Toxic Breath and Septic Spatter pools, and cover the rest with Healing Stream Totem and Riptide.

[탱버] If the seven Ravenous Descendants' Ravenous Claws stacks (10% attack speed for 2 sec per swing) hurt the tank, drop Capacitor Totem (1 min, 3 sec stun within 8 yards after 2 sec) at the tank's feet to buy time for the stacks to fall off.
2: [광역 피해] Line up Healing Tide Totem (Totemic, 2 min with First Ascendant) or Ascendance (Farseer, 3 min) with Blood Sacrifice (87284 Physical to the whole party, then a 162029 heal absorb), which Topicx says is where defensives go, to burn through the heal absorb right away.
[탱버] If the tank is low after Ritual Chieftain's Dismember (3 sec cast, 581895 Physical), cast an instant Healing Wave with Nature's Swiftness (Ancestral Swiftness for Farseer).
3: [차단] The three Primal Serpents walking down behind the pillar need all three kicks. Take one with Wind Shear, and when all three gather in front of the tank, drop Capacitor Totem to stun out the remaining Piercing Hiss.

[광역 피해] The Healing Tide Totem or Ascendance from pull 2 is not back yet. Drop Healing Stream Totem and Stormstream Totem before Blood Sacrifice, and burn the heal absorb with Chain Heal on top of Surging Totem (Totemic) or Healing Rain (Farseer).
4: [광역 피해] If Healing Tide Totem (2 min) is back, use it again on this pull's Blood Sacrifice; if not, pre-place Surging Totem (Totemic) or Healing Rain (Farseer) where the party stands and burn the absorb with Chain Heal.
5: [광역 피해] Paralyzing Shots DoTs from two Twinfang Harrowers overlap with the Blood Sacrifice absorb, and Topicx says this is hard to heal through on high keys. Use Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) on Blood Sacrifice, and if the party keeps dropping, drop Spirit Link Totem (3 min, 10% less damage taken and health redistribution within 10 yards for 6 sec) in the middle of the party.
[해제] Paralyzing Shots comes from two Harrowers, so one Purify Spirit (8 sec) cannot clear it all. Clear the player with the most slow stacks first.
7: [해제] Drop Poison Cleansing Totem (2 min) to clear High Evolutionist's Envenom (Poison, 24246 Nature every 1 sec for 8 sec) before it overlaps with Rattling Writhe's Rattle (3 sec cast, 58189 armor-ignoring Physical every 1 sec for 5 sec). Wowhead also says Poison Cleansing Totem is especially strong against the heavy DoTs in the first half of this dungeon.
[차단] Kick the Evolve channel (6 sec, ends with a shield and crowd control immunity) with Wind Shear, and if Wind Shear is already used, stun it out with Capacitor Totem.
[탱버] Corrosive Fangs (3 sec cast, 242456 Nature, 20% more damage taken for 20 sec) is not reduced by armor, so keep Riptide on the tank for those 20 sec and focus Healing Wave on the tank.
8: [광역 피해] When you see the 3 sec Rattle cast, drop Healing Stream Totem and Stormstream Totem to take the 5 sec armor-ignoring Physical AoE.
[탱버] If the tank is low during Corrosive Fangs' 20 sec damage-taken increase, cast an instant Healing Wave with Nature's Swiftness (Ancestral Swiftness, 30 sec, for Farseer).
9: [차단] Topicx assigns the kick on the far-left High Evolutionist to a ranged player (the shaman in his video). Kick its casts with Wind Shear (30 yards) so it walks to the tank.

[해제] Mass Envenom has no dispel type, so Poison Cleansing Totem cannot remove it. Save Poison Cleansing Totem for Envenom poison and heal through the 8 sec Mass Envenom DoT with Healing Stream Totem and Chain Heal.
11: [차단] Each of the four High Evolutionists needs a kicker, so take one with Wind Shear, and stop any unkicked Evolve channel by dropping Capacitor Totem where the Evolutionists stand together.
[해제] If Envenom poison lands on several players, drop Poison Cleansing Totem in the middle of the party. The totem clears one player within 30 yards every 1.5 sec for 6 sec.
12: [광역 피해] When the party stacks on the tank's ping for Infest (34914 Nature every 1 sec for 5 sec, then 69827 Nature within 8 yards), place Surging Totem (Totemic) or Healing Rain (Farseer) on that spot and top everyone with Chain Heal before the bursts. Move a pre-placed Healing Stream Totem there with Totemic Projection.

[탱버] Ascendant Serpent's Noxious Spray (3 sec cast, 67888 Nature every 1 sec for 5 sec) keeps hitting while it pushes the tank back, so put Riptide on the tank on the cast and keep the pushed tank up with Healing Wave from within 40 yards.
13: [광역 피해] Ula'tek's Chosen's Toxic Surge (29095 Nature to the whole party every 1 sec for 9 sec) comes with Toxic Beam (339438 Nature). Use Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) as Surge starts, and turn on Spiritwalker's Grace (1 min 30 sec with Graceful Spirit) to keep casting Chain Heal while dodging the Beam.
[차단] Topicx stuns Blade of the Altar during Toxic Surge. As Surge starts, drop Capacitor Totem where the two Blades stand to stop their Laced Edge teleports.
[참고] If several Living Venoms die at once and Venom Burst damage stacks up, take it right away with Healing Stream Totem and Chain Heal.
14: [광역 피해] Topicx says to use party defensives on this pull's Toxic Surge. When Surge starts, drop Spirit Link Totem in the middle of the party, dodge Toxic Beam, then refill with Chain Heal.
[차단] If the Capacitor Totem (1 min) from pull 13 is back, drop it on the two Blades of the Altar again as Toxic Surge starts.
15: [차단] Take one of the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss with Wind Shear.
[해제] Clear Paralyzing Shots with Purify Spirit. Clear players who also have Blade of the Altar's Laced Edge Nature DoT first.
16: [광역 피해] Two Ritual Chieftains chain Blood Sacrifice and Ula'tek's Chosen adds Toxic Surge, which Topicx calls the heaviest healing pull. Use Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) on the first Blood Sacrifice, and if Spirit Link Totem is back, drop it when Toxic Surge overlaps with the second Blood Sacrifice.
[차단] Put Wind Shear in the Mass Envenom rotation for Ula'tek's Chosen so DoTs do not stack while the group kills the Chosen first.

[탱버] Dismember comes from two Chieftains, so use Nature's Swiftness (1 min) on the first and take the second with Riptide pre-placed on the tank and Healing Wave. As Farseer, Ancestral Swiftness (30 sec) gives an instant Healing Wave for both.

1: [광역 피해] Topicx only lusts when he pulls Bribed Captain and Bribed Guard together. If you pull both, cast Bloodlust or Heroism, and if the tank struggles, add Healing Tide Totem (Totemic, 2 min with First Ascendant) or Ascendance (Farseer, 3 min).

[해제] When the two Street Sneaks' Heartstop Poison (193965 Nature over 8 sec, 5% max health reduction per stack) stacks on the tank, drop Poison Cleansing Totem (2 min) within 30 yards of the tank. Topicx also says this poison needs a dispel on high keys.

[탱버] If the Captain's attacks overlap with the 20 sec, 20% Physical damage-taken increase from Bribed Guard's Shield Bash, cast an instant Healing Wave on the tank with Nature's Swiftness (Ancestral Swiftness for Farseer).
2: [차단] The two Seductive Sayaads' Seduction (3 sec cast, 6 sec disorient) needs one kicker per Sayaad, so take one with Wind Shear (12 sec). Wowhead says Seduction can be interrupted, which is why it picks Poison Cleansing Totem over Tremor Totem in this dungeon.
[해제] If Seduction lands, it is a Magic effect, so remove it right away with Purify Spirit (8 sec) to break the 6 sec disorient.
4: [해제] The four Street Sneaks stack Heartstop Poison fast, and Topicx says dispellers struggle to keep up here. If the Poison Cleansing Totem (2 min) from pull 1 is back, drop it in the middle of the party once stacks spread across several players so it clears one player every 1.5 sec for 6 sec.
[광역 피해] Players still poisoned have reduced max health, so keep them topped with Healing Stream Totem and Riptide.
5: [해제] Massive Felwyrm's Corroding Spittle (58189 Fire on hit, then 106681 Fire every 3 sec for 30 sec) is a Magic effect, so remove it with Purify Spirit. Topicx also tells the target to call for a dispel.
[광역 피해] Massive Felwyrm's Over-infused deals 38793 Fire to everyone within 50 yards every 3 sec, so drop Healing Stream Totem and Surging Totem (Healing Rain for Farseer) on cooldown.
8: [광역 피해] Below 50% health, Shivan Punisher's Demonic Frenzy deals 29095 Fire to the whole party every 1 sec until it dies. Use Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) when it hits 50%.

[차단] Put Wind Shear in the Health Funnel rotation for Fel Invoker, and prioritize Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage (3.5 sec cast, 60% less damage taken and crowd control immunity for 1 min) whenever Wind Shear is available.
9: [해제] Corrupted Warlock's Curse of Doom (1.5 sec cast, 581895 Shadow after 10 sec, split among players within 4 yards of the target) is a Curse, so remove it immediately with Purify Spirit (Improved Purify Spirit). Topicx's guide also calls this curse dispel very important.
[참고] The Drain Life target uses a defensive or leaves combat, so put Riptide on them and focus Healing Wave on them to limit how much the Warlock heals.
10: [광역 피해] When Shivan Punisher drops below 50% and starts Demonic Frenzy, use the Healing Tide Totem from pull 8 if it is back; if not, drop Spirit Link Totem (3 min).
[차단] Kick Fel Invoker's first Health Funnel with Wind Shear.
11: [광역 피해] Felmaster Lucsei's Blade Dance (43642 Fire to everyone every 0.4 sec for 1.2 sec) is the AoE where Topicx splits personal and party defensives. Use Spirit Link Totem on the first Blade Dance and Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) on the next.
[탱버] The two Trained Felhunters' Shadow Bite adds Shadow damage on the tank, so keep Earth Shield and Riptide on the tank.
13: [광역 피해] Defiled Golem's Defiled Slam (145474 Fire to everyone, plus nearby Defiled Detonations) is where Topicx uses party defensives. Use Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) on the first Slam.
[차단] Drop Capacitor Totem (1 min, 3 sec stun within 8 yards after 2 sec) where the six Unleashed Imps stand to stop their Felfire Burst together, and save Wind Shear for Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage.
14: [차단] Stun the six Unleashed Imps together with Capacitor Totem, and use Wind Shear on Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage or Fel Invoker's Health Funnel.
[탱버] The two Trained Felhunters' Shadow Bite stacks up on the tank, so keep Earth Shield and Riptide on the tank.
15: [해제] Remove Corrupted Warlock's Curse of Doom immediately with Purify Spirit. Topicx pulls the Warlock back and kills it first, then handles Shivan Punisher separately.

[광역 피해] If both come together and Drain Life overlaps with Demonic Frenzy, drop Spirit Link Totem in the middle of the party and put Riptide on the Drain Life target. If you split them, save Spirit Link Totem for pull 16.
16: [광역 피해] Topicx says Defiled Golem's AoE should end within two casts, so assign two party defensives. Use Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) on the first Defiled Slam and Spirit Link Totem on the second. The pull is long enough for them to come back before the boss (Topicx).
[차단] The two Fel Invokers rarely cast Health Funnel, so take one with Wind Shear.

1: [광역 피해] Topicx uses lust and all cooldowns on this pull. Once the tank groups the casters, cast Bloodlust or Heroism and line up Healing Tide Totem (Totemic, 2 min with First Ascendant) or Ascendance (Farseer, 3 min) with the Feast of Misery channel (38793 Shadow to the whole party every 1 sec for 5 sec).

[해제] The Spirit of Hunger totem's Insatiable Hunger (15% max health reduction, stacking) is a Curse, so remove it with Purify Spirit (8 sec, Improved Purify Spirit). Topicx says the curse overlapping with Feast of Misery is dangerous, so clear the lowest player first before Feast.

[참고] Razor Dive bleeds from the three Keen-Eyed Strikers (33944 Physical every 1 sec for 10 sec, stacking) cannot be dispelled by this spec. Put Riptide on the player with stacks and focus Healing Wave on them.
2: [차단] Kick Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze (3.5 sec cast, heals nearby allies for 5% max health every 2 sec) with Wind Shear (12 sec), and if it lands, remove it with Purge. Wowhead says purging Healing Breeze is very important in this dungeon.
[해제] Remove the Insatiable Hunger curse with Purify Spirit, while the party hits the Starvation Effigy first so it dies before the second stack.
3: [차단] Kick Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze with Wind Shear, and Purge it if the kick is missed.

[광역 피해] The Healing Tide Totem or Ascendance from pull 1 is not back yet. Drop Healing Stream Totem and Stormstream Totem before Feast of Misery, and Purify Spirit players who also have Insatiable Hunger first.
4: [참고] When Razor Dive bleeds from the three Keen-Eyed Strikers stack on one player, put Riptide on them and cast an instant Healing Wave with Nature's Swiftness (Ancestral Swiftness for Farseer).
[해제] Remove Spirit of Hunger's Insatiable Hunger curse with Purify Spirit. If Healing Tide Totem (2 min) is back, use it on Feast of Misery.
5: [탱버] The tank drags this pack to the boss area alone while the party clicks the boss-summon barrels, so pre-place Earth Shield and Riptide on the tank and turn on Spiritwalker's Grace (1 min 30 sec with Graceful Spirit) to follow and keep casting Healing Wave.
[차단] Kick Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze with Wind Shear, and Purge it if the kick is missed.

8: [광역 피해] Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward deals 24246 Nature to the whole party every 2 sec while the shield is up. Drop Healing Stream Totem and Surging Totem (Healing Rain for Farseer) on cooldown to take it.

[탱버] The two Territorial Matriarchs and five Frostfangs hit only the tank, so keep Riptide on the tank and, if their health drops fast, cast an instant Healing Wave with Nature's Swiftness (Ancestral Swiftness for Farseer).
9: [광역 피해] Topicx calls this the second lust pull. Cast Bloodlust or Heroism and, if Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) is back, line it up with the Rumbling Ward damage.
[차단] The two Frigid Maulers' Frigid Roar (3.5 sec cast) cuts haste and movement speed by 50%, which slows your healing. The long cast is easy to kick, so take one with Wind Shear.

10: [광역 피해] Topicx calls this the cooldown pull after lust. If you used your big cooldown on pull 9, use Spirit Link Totem here and drop Healing Stream Totem and Stormstream Totem on cooldown.
[해제] Alternate Purify Spirit (8 sec) between Cryo Surge from the two Glacial Revenants. A target you cannot clear should move more than 4 yards from the party.
[차단] Kick one of the two Frigid Maulers' Frigid Roar with Wind Shear.
11: [광역 피해] Avatar of Determination's Glacial Tomb (2 sec cast) encases the whole party and deals 38793 Frost every 2 sec until broken. When you see the cast, drop Healing Stream Totem and Surging Totem (Healing Rain for Farseer) first to cover the damage while encased.
[해제] Remove Glacial Revenant's Cryo Surge with Purify Spirit.
13: [광역 피해] The two Grizzled Warbringers' Primal Echo (armor-ignoring Physical party damage, stacking) is the AoE Topicx says needs defensives on high keys. Use Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) on the first Echo and Spirit Link Totem on the next.

14: [광역 피해] Topicx names this pull a third-lust option on lower keys and says to save lust for Loa Speaker Nanea on high keys. While the two Ruthless Totemcallers' Magma Totems (36368 Fire to everyone every 0.3 sec) are up, drop Healing Stream Totem, Surging Totem (Healing Rain for Farseer) and Stormstream Totem on cooldown.
[차단] Kick Stormbound Mystic's Arc Lightning with Wind Shear.
15: [광역 피해] The four Grizzled Warbringers never cast Primal Echo at the same time. As Topicx says, top the party before the next Echo, and assign whichever of Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) and Spirit Link Totem is back to each Echo.
[차단] Take one of the two Stormbound Mystics' Arc Lightning with Wind Shear, and when both stand together, stop them with Capacitor Totem (1 min, 3 sec stun within 8 yards after 2 sec).
16: [광역 피해] Topicx uses lust here on high keys. Party damage spikes each time a Volatile Totem wave goes off, so use Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) on the first wave and Spirit Link Totem on the second.
[차단] Put Wind Shear in the Lightning Bolt rotation for Loa Speaker Nanea.

1: [광역 피해] This is Topicx's first lust pull. Once Voidtouched Magi is dragged into the room and the hallway mobs are gathered, cast Bloodlust or Heroism, and if even one Shadowbolt Volley (4 sec cast, 193965 Shadow to everyone within 60 yards) kick is missed, use Healing Tide Totem (Totemic, 2 min with First Ascendant) or Ascendance (Farseer, 3 min).
[차단] Topicx assigns one kicker to each of the two Enthralled Shamans. Take one Shaman's Lava Bolt (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Fire) with Wind Shear (12 sec).

[탱버] When Feral Saberon's Savage Leap bleed (38793 Physical every 1 sec for 5 sec) stacks on the tank, put Riptide on the tank and cast an instant Healing Wave with Nature's Swiftness (Ancestral Swiftness for Farseer). This bleed cannot be dispelled.

For Raj'kess the Spellstorm's Thundering Storm (Topicx: a 9 sec party AoE), drop Spirit Link Totem (3 min, 10% less damage taken and health redistribution within 10 yards for 6 sec) in the middle of the party and add Healing Stream Totem and Stormstream Totem.

3: [광역 피해] Line up Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) with Chitigoth's Insidious Aura (87284 Nature to everyone within 100 yards every 2 sec for 10 sec), which Topicx says needs healing cooldowns on high keys. If Angry Krolusk's Violent Sand (3 sec cast, 155172 Nature to everyone) overlaps, add Spirit Link Totem if it is back.

5: [차단] Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek (3.5 sec cast, 6 sec fear within 60 yards) is the kick Topicx calls the most important in this area. Wowhead also picks Poison Cleansing Totem over Tremor Totem on the assumption that Mad Shriek is always kicked, so save Wind Shear for Mad Shriek.

[광역 피해] When the party gathers in Watchful Harrower's Sky Strike circle (5 sec cast, 872842 Nature shared among everyone within 10 yards), pre-place Surging Totem (Totemic) or Healing Rain (Farseer) there and refill with Chain Heal after the knock-up.
6: [광역 피해] Brutal Overseer's Brutal Slams (48491 Physical to everyone every 1.5 sec, 10% stronger per slam until the shield breaks) is the AoE Topicx says needs healing cooldowns on high keys. Use Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) once the slams start stacking, and if they overlap with Watchful Harrower's Sky Strike soak, drop Spirit Link Totem inside the circle.
[차단] Kick Enthralled Shaman's Lava Bolt with Wind Shear.
8: [광역 피해] Use Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) on Devouring Brutalizer's Dreadbellow (4.5 sec cast, knocks everyone back and deals 29095 Shadow every 1 sec for 12 sec, undispellable). Healing Tide Totem heals everyone within 40 yards even after the knockback scatters the party.

9: [광역 피해] If you used your big cooldown on pull 8, drop Spirit Link Totem where the party regroups after this pull's Dreadbellow knockback, and take the 12 sec DoT with Healing Stream Totem and Stormstream Totem.
[차단] Kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Wind Shear. If Wind Shear is on cooldown, leave Enthralled Shaman's Lava Bolt to another player.
10: [광역 피해] Devouring Brutalizer's Dreadbellow and Watchful Harrower's Sky Strike come back to back, so if Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) is back, use it on Dreadbellow and pre-place Surging Totem (Healing Rain for Farseer) in the Sky Strike circle.
[탱버] If the tank drops during the 6 sec Brutalize channel, cast an instant Healing Wave with Nature's Swiftness (Ancestral Swiftness for Farseer).

1: [해제] Minion of Zul on the way die when their Bound by Shadow shield (Magic) is removed. Topicx leaves these purges to the shaman and mage in the group, so use Purge (30 yards) on Minions of Zul the tank has stunned. Wowhead also rates Purge as useful in King's Rest.

[광역 피해] This is the first Bloodlust pull of the dungeon. Line up Healing Tide Totem (Totemic, 2 min with First Ascendant) or Ascendance (Farseer, 3 min) with Bloodlust, and when Shadow-Borne Champion starts casting Shadow Whirlwind (4 sec cast, 164870 Shadow to the whole party within 100 yards), drop Healing Stream Totem and Stormstream Totem and refill with Chain Heal right after the hit.
2: [해제] If Risen Hexer's Hex Volley is not kicked, the hit players get a curse dealing 38793 Shadow every 1 sec for 12 sec. Both M+ builds take Improved Purify Spirit, so Purify Spirit (8 sec) removes curses too; clear the lowest player first.
[차단] Put Wind Shear (12 sec) in the Hex Volley (3.5 sec cast) kick rotation.

[광역 피해] The big cooldown used with pull 1's Bloodlust is not back yet. Take Shadow Whirlwind with Healing Stream Totem and Stormstream Totem, and save Spirit Link Totem (3 min) for Serpentine Gust on the next boss, The Golden Serpent.
4: [탱버] Topicx calls the King A'akul and Bloodsworn Assassin pack the hardest one. When Blood Drain (164870 Physical to bleeding targets) comes on a tank with Mortal Bleed (48491 Physical every 1 sec for 18 sec, 20% less healing taken) and Sudden Rupture stacked, cast an instant Healing Wave with Nature's Swiftness (Ancestral Swiftness for Farseer), and if it is still dangerous, drop Spirit Link Totem next to the tank.

[광역 피해] The four Bloodsworn Assassins' Sudden Rupture (24246 Physical every 1 sec for 18 sec) is a bleed Purify Spirit cannot remove. Use Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer), back since pull 1, as this pack wakes up, and keep Riptide rolling on bleeding players.
[차단] Kick Seneschal M'bara's Unholy Mending (heals 7% health every 2 sec for 10 sec) with Wind Shear, and if it goes through, it is a Magic effect, so Purge it off the healed mob.
5: [광역 피해] Topicx's healer died to Purification Construct's Purifying Flame (174568 Fire to the whole party, then a zone). Use whichever of Healing Tide Totem, Ascendance, or Spirit Link Totem is back on the first Purifying Flame, and turn on Spiritwalker's Grace (1 min 30 sec with Graceful Spirit) to keep casting Chain Heal while backing up on the bridge.

6: [차단] The two Half-Finished Mummies' Wretched Discharge (4 sec cast, a disease on the whole party, 116379 Nature every 2 sec for 12 sec) cannot be removed by Restoration Shaman. Put Wind Shear in the kick rotation, and if a kick is missed, drop Capacitor Totem (1 min, 3 sec stun within 8 yards after 2 sec) on both mummies by the crypt.

[광역 피해] While the Entomb target is locked in, Wail of Mourning (77586 Shadow to the whole party every 2 sec, growing over time) continues. Place Surging Totem (Totemic) or Healing Rain (Farseer) by the crypt where the party stands and refill with Chain Heal.
7: [차단] Put Wind Shear in the Wretched Discharge kick rotation, and if the Capacitor Totem (1 min) from pull 6 is back, drop it again on a mummy whose kick was missed.

[해제] If Putrid Seekers poison from the eight Embalming Fluids stacks on several players, drop Poison Cleansing Totem again once the one from pull 5 (2 min) is back. The totem clears one player within 30 yards every 1.5 sec for 6 sec.
9: [해제] Players hit by Phantom Hex Priest's Hex (3.5 sec cast, Curse, 5 sec incapacitate) can be freed with Purify Spirit. Free a kicker first.

[참고] The two Royal Berserkers' Bloodthirsty Axe (29095 Physical every 1 sec for 12 sec, up to 2 players) is a bleed you cannot remove. Put Riptide on hit players and support them with Healing Stream Totem.
10: [광역 피해] On a four-Bloodlust route, Topicx uses the third Bloodlust on this pull. Line up Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) with Bloodlust, and if anyone was late out of Seismic Upheaval (5 sec cast, 387930 Physical nearby and a knock-up), Chain Heal them right after they land.

[해제] Free players hit by Phantom Hex Priest's Hex with Purify Spirit, and spend Wind Shear on the Hex Priest's Spectral Bolt and Hex.
12: [탱버] Shadow of Zul's Shadow Barrage (58190 Shadow, then 48491 Shadow every 2 sec for 4 sec) hits whoever engages first. Put Earth Shield and Riptide on the tank before they engage, and if another player gets hit first, put Riptide on that player.
[위치] Soaking the far Pool of Darkness as the healer hurts a lot, as Topicx says. Turn on Astral Shift (2 min, 40% less damage taken for 12 sec) before stepping in.
[해제] Minions of Zul summoned by Dark Revelation (473120 Shadow within 20 yards after 5 sec) die when their Bound by Shadow shield (Magic) is removed, so Purge it off.

1: [차단] The two Flashfrost Chillweavers' Ice Shield channel (15 sec, a shield and crowd control immunity on an ally every 3 sec) must be kicked, so take one with Wind Shear (12 sec).

2: [해제] Touching an egg in the water spawns Infused Whelps whose Cold Claws (Magic) becomes Frozen Solid at 20 stacks. Clear the player with the most stacks first with Purify Spirit (8 sec).
[차단] Kick Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield channel with Wind Shear.
3: [탱버] Defier Draghar's Steel Barrage (242456 Physical to the tank every 0.5 sec for 3 sec) is the flurry Topicx wants a tank defensive for every time. On the 1 sec cast, put Riptide on the tank and cast an instant Healing Wave with Nature's Swiftness (Ancestral Swiftness for Farseer).
[광역 피해] Each Steel Barrage strike sends a 24246 Fire nova to the whole party within 60 yards, six times. Support the party with Healing Stream Totem and Stormstream Totem while you heal the tank.
[차단] Kick Flashfrost Chillweaver with Wind Shear so Ice Shield does not shield Draghar.
5: [광역 피해] Blazebound Destroyer's Inferno (party Fire damage plus a 5 sec DoT) is what Topicx calls entirely the healer's job. Use Healing Tide Totem (Totemic, 2 min with First Ascendant) or Ascendance (Farseer, 3 min) on the first Inferno, and take later ones with Healing Stream Totem plus Surging Totem (Totemic) or Healing Rain (Farseer).

[차단] Topicx wants kicks on Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Fire) first, so spend Wind Shear there too. The two Ashseer Flamelashers' Flaming Barrage (10 sec channel, 96982 Fire + 242456 Physical to the tank every 1 sec) cannot be interrupted, so stun both with Capacitor Totem when they stand together.
[해제] Purge (30 yards) off the Blaze of Glory (15 sec channel, 290947 Fire embers every 3 sec) that Flamelashers cast on death. Wowhead says Purge is your only valuable utility in this dungeon.
6: [광역 피해] Below 50% health, Flamegullet's Molten Blood (48491 Fire within 60 yards every 3 sec, 15% more per cast up to 10 times) keeps ramping party damage. On 17+ keys Topicx uses Bloodlust at 50%, so line up Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) then, and if the cooldown from pull 5 is not back, use Spirit Link Totem (3 min).

[탱버] When Flamegullet's Fire Maw (581895 Physical + 96982 Fire, then 77586 Fire every 1 sec for 6 sec) overlaps with Blazebound Destroyer's Fiery Blast (4 sec cast, 358835 Fire) on the tank, cast an instant Healing Wave with Nature's Swiftness.
[해제] Purge off the Blaze of Glory that the Ashseer Flamelasher casts as it dies.
7: [차단] The two Ashseer Flamelashers' Flaming Barrage cannot be interrupted, so stun both with Capacitor Totem (1 min) when they stand together, and spend Wind Shear on Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt.
[해제] Purge off each Blaze of Glory as the two Flamelashers die.
[광역 피해] Inferno repeats, so drop Healing Stream Totem on cooldown, and use a returned big cooldown when the Inferno DoT overlaps with a Living Bomb explosion (69827 Fire within 6 yards).
8: [차단] If the Capacitor Totem (1 min) from pull 7 is back, drop it again on the two Flamelashers' Flaming Barrage, and keep Wind Shear on Cinderbolt.
[해제] Purge off Blaze of Glory from dead Flamelashers.
10: [광역 피해] Thunderous Stomp (53340 Nature within 60 yards) from six Storm Warriors lands all at once. Pre-place Surging Totem (Totemic) or Healing Rain (Farseer) where the party stands and refill with Chain Heal.
[참고] Put Riptide on the player taking Tempest Channeler's Lightning Torrent (7 sec channel, 65463 Nature every 1 sec), and if they drop low, cast an instant Healing Wave with Nature's Swiftness.
[차단] Stop Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with a Capacitor Totem stun, and Purge off its Blaze of Glory when it dies.
11: [참고] Topicx chain-pulls this section without stopping, so big cooldowns tend to be down. Put Riptide on the Lightning Torrent target and move your pre-placed Healing Stream Totem along with the party using Totemic Projection (10 sec).
[차단] Spend Wind Shear on Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt.
12: [광역 피해] While High Channeler Ryvati's Tempest Stormshield (absorbs 20% of its health) is up, the whole party takes 29095 Nature every 1 sec, and if it expires unbroken, everyone within 60 yards is stunned for 4 sec. Topicx also notes the heavy healing load until the shield breaks, so line up Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) with the shield, and if health keeps dropping, use Spirit Link Totem.
[해제] Purge off the Stormcloud Barrier (Magic, a shield equal to 85% health) on clouds from Summon Primal Thunderclouds. A stripped cloud explodes with Stormcloud Detonation (Wowhead).

1: [차단] Topicx says people die when Storm Adept's Lightning Bolt (116379 Nature) overlaps with Sandfury Stonefist's Ground Pound (4 sec cast, 156627 Physical within 60 yards and a knockback). During the Ground Pound cast, spend Wind Shear (12 sec) on Storm Adept's Lightning Bolt.
[광역 피해] When you see the Ground Pound cast, drop Healing Stream Totem and Stormstream Totem, and refill with Chain Heal once the knockback ends.
[해제] If anyone is hit by Shrouded Fang's Poisoned Cheap Shot (Poison, a stun plus 96982 Nature every 1 sec for 5 sec), drop Poison Cleansing Totem (2 min) right away.
2: [해제] Clear Poisoned Cheap Shot poison from the two Shrouded Fangs below the stairs with Poison Cleansing Totem if the one from pull 1 is back; if not, put Riptide on the hit player and cast an instant Healing Wave with Nature's Swiftness (Ancestral Swiftness for Farseer).

[차단] During Ground Pound, spend Wind Shear on Storm Adept's Lightning Bolt, and stop Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage (9 sec channel, 43642 Physical every 0.8 sec) with Capacitor Totem (1 min, 3 sec stun within 8 yards after 2 sec).
4: [해제] Poisonous Viper's Cytotoxin (Poison, 72737 Nature plus 38793 Nature every 1 sec for 10 sec) is dangerous when it overlaps with Lightning Bolt. Drop Poison Cleansing Totem when the poison is on two or more players. Wowhead also says Poison Cleansing Totem and Purge save a lot of group damage in this dungeon.
[차단] Kick Storm Adept's Lightning Bolt with Wind Shear.
5: [광역 피해] Topicx says this pull breaks the party and the healer when Lightning Bolt lands on someone hit by a Krolusk leap or Cytotoxin. Use Healing Tide Totem (Totemic, 2 min with First Ascendant) or Ascendance (Farseer, 3 min) as the Sand-Sworn Rider joins.
[차단] Take one of the two Storm Adepts' Lightning Bolt with Wind Shear.
[해제] Clear Cytotoxin poison with Poison Cleansing Totem, and cover Barbed Krolusk's Serrated Charge bleed (38793 Physical every 1 sec for 6 sec), which you cannot remove, with Riptide.
6: [해제] Free players hit by Faithless Subjugator's Addle Mind (5 sec cast, Curse, 5 sec disorient) with Purify Spirit (8 sec). Both M+ builds take Improved Purify Spirit, so it removes curses too.
[차단] Put Wind Shear in the kick rotation for Brood Tender's Venom Bolt (116379 Nature).
7: [해제] Cytotoxin poison from three Poisonous Vipers stacks on several players, so use Poison Cleansing Totem on this pull. The totem clears one player within 30 yards every 1.5 sec for 6 sec. Topicx warns about Venom Bolt landing on top of Cytotoxin.
[차단] Kick Brood Tender's Venom Bolt with Wind Shear, and free players hit by Addle Mind with Purify Spirit.
9: [해제] Purge (30 yards) the Accumulate Charge (Magic, 8% more damage per stack, up to 3) off both Agitated Nimbuses to shrink Release Charge. Wowhead rates Purge as highly valuable in this dungeon.
[해제] Imbued Stormcaller's Imbued Conduction (Magic, 42672 Nature every 1 sec for 20 sec) drops Conduct Lightning when it expires, so clear it with Purify Spirit before then.

[광역 피해] Topicx says to let the first Release Charge (3 sec cast, 145474 Nature to the whole party) go off and let the healer top the group before running the Loose Sparks section. Refill with Healing Stream Totem and Chain Heal right after Release Charge, and if the two Nimbuses' Release Charges stagger into back-to-back hits, use Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer).
10: [광역 피해] Topicx calls this a dangerous pull. Agitated Nimbus, two Imbued Stormcallers, and four Static Anomalies come together, so pull after the first Release Charge and use Spirit Link Totem (3 min) on the next Release Charge.
[해제] If Imbued Conduction lands on two players, Purify Spirit frees only one every 8 sec, so clear the player who got it first, and Purge the Nimbus's Accumulate Charge.
[차단] Take one of the two Stormcallers' Lightning Bolt with Wind Shear.
12: [광역 피해] For Orb Watcher's Caustic Stomp (3.5 sec cast, 116379 Nature within 60 yards plus 33459 Nature every 1 sec for 10 sec), drop Healing Stream Totem when you see the cast and keep Surging Totem (Totemic) or Healing Rain (Farseer) where the party stands.
[차단] Temple Disruptor's Essence Disruption channel stops the orb from charging. Kick the Disruptor on the tank's side with Wind Shear and stun the one on the far side with Capacitor Totem.
13: [광역 피해] If the Caustic Stomp DoT keeps ticking, drop Healing Stream Totem on cooldown, and if health keeps falling, use Healing Tide Totem (Totemic) or Ascendance (Farseer) if still available after pull 12. If the Capacitor Totem (1 min) from pull 12 is back, drop it on the far-side Disruptor again.
14: [위치] The four Faithless Tormentors chase only the healer, and each melee hit applies Shadowlash, cutting your healing done by 5% per stack. Walk toward the tank, stun the Tormentors with Capacitor Totem once they bunch up near the tank, and turn on Astral Shift (2 min, 40% less damage taken for 12 sec) if they catch you together.
[차단] Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock (4 sec cast, 242456 Fire plus an 8 sec DoT) must be kicked, so put Wind Shear in the kick rotation.

[참고] Put Riptide on the Latent Hex target (31519 Shadow every 1 sec for 4 sec) as they leave the group. When it ends it bursts for 77586 Shadow within 10 yards, so have a Healing Wave ready for the target.
